title: ClearFront: extract js/state.js (deck/side/game-state setup)
description: First engine-layer decomposition slice per DEC-CF-004 (Projects/ClearFront/shared/decisions.md). Extract from app/index.html's remaining inline IIFE into Projects/ClearFront/app/js/state.js: buildDecklist, applyDeckIdentity, showDeckSelect, makeCard, shuffle, createSide, resetGame, sideOf, otherSide, controllerLabel, championDef, resetChampionTurnFlags, championDeployReason, deployChampion, returnChampionToSlot, saveUndo, clearUndo, canUndo, undoLastAction, aiConsiderChampion, addLog, dealStartingHand, drawCard, refillHand, replaceCard, startTurn. These functions read/write the shared mutable state object (state, clashTimers, undoRecord) that stays declared once in app/index.html's remaining inline script -- decide and document the exact sharing mechanism (e.g. functions attached to window.CF that close over a state reference passed in, or state itself hoisted onto window.CF so state.js's functions can read/write it directly) since this is the first slice moving MUTABLE state access across a file boundary, not just pure data (TASK-208 only moved static data). Do not move combat/AI functions (js/combat.js is a separate later task, TASK-213+) or render functions. No ES modules, no build step, no server (DEC-CF-002). Do not touch source/ or baseline/.
acceptance_criteria: All 25 listed functions are moved verbatim (logic unchanged) into app/js/state.js.
The mutable-state-sharing mechanism is explicit and documented in the parity report (not just 'it worked'), since combat.js will depend on the same pattern in TASK-213+.

app/index.html opens directly via file:// and is visually + functionally identical to the pre-TASK-212 app/index.html: byte-identical champion-select screenshot, and a CDP interaction test through at least one full turn (play a card, attack, end turn) with zero console errors/exceptions.
node --check passes on state.js and the remaining inline script.
